evidence.source: Micron official FBGA decoder API and obsolete DDR5 part catalog
evidence.notes: The exact official responses confirm the structural MT60 token positions. The obsolete catalog directly identifies 1500M16 as 24Gb x16; 12G4/6G8, 16G4/8G8, and 32G4 use the documented depth-times-width organization. Official DDR5 addenda and the core speed-bin table separately support the numeric 80/88/92 data rates. EGN and KC package ball count and dimensions remain unpublished.

evidence.source: Micron official 16Gb Automotive Die Rev D, 24Gb Die Rev B, and 32Gb Die Rev B/E DDR5 addenda
evidence.notes: Ordering pp. 1-3 and mechanical drawings confirm revision-scoped configuration, speed, temperature, package, and revision tokens. The 32Gb Rev E addendum contains only 8G4/4G8/2G16 SDP parts and no 32G4, EGN, D8JJB, 88H, or 92H; it does not establish the target 3DS package or H-bin timings. Its p. 16 RZ drawing appears copied from the older AT package and conflicts with the 7.5x11 summary on pp. 1 and 3, so RZ dimensions continue to rely on the internally consistent 16Gb Rev H addendum.

evidence.source: Micron official 16Gb DDR5 Die Rev H addendum, DDR5 core speed-bin tables, and FBGA decoder API
evidence.notes: The addendum ordering diagram places the three-character value in the Speed field and maps numeric 80 to 8000 MT/s for B-bin parts. DDR5 core pp. 433-435 shows that the numeric data rate is shared across multiple trailing timing-bin letters. H timing and CL remain undisclosed, so the public value is DDR5-8000 without a CL claim.

evidence.source: Micron official 16Gb DDR5 Die Rev H addendum, DDR5 core speed-bin tables, and FBGA decoder API
evidence.notes: Addendum pp. 2-3 maps numeric 88 to 8800 MT/s and separates Speed from the colon-prefixed Revision. DDR5 core pp. 433-435 lists multiple timing-bin suffixes at the same 8800 MT/s data rate. H timing and CL remain undisclosed, so 88B CL72 is not reused.

evidence.notes: The addendum maps numeric 92 to 9200 MT/s and independently identifies the trailing B timing bin. Exact official decoder rows confirm H in the same Speed position. H timing and CL remain undisclosed, so the public value is DDR5-9200 without a CL claim.

evidence.source: Micron eMMC 4GB/8GB/16GB/32GB 100-ball industrial datasheet, Rev C 7/12, Figure 2 Marketing Part Number Chart

evidence.source: Micron official UFS-based MCP catalog and public document-search metadata for UM278, UM22Q, UM27E and UM27G

evidence.notes: Only BG component, WT temperature and EE status are public. 1T5 total capacity, BE product/interface binding and QW/QX package remain unconfirmed and are omitted.
